[Unit]
Description=CPU-only verified all-method V2 baseline completion publisher
After=default.target
[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/data1/liyapeng/program/LLMCL
Environment=CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nohup /data1/liyapeng/program/LLMCL/.assets-env/bin/python -u /data1/liyapeng/program/LLMCL/analysis/v2_verified_baseline_report.py --mode watch
StandardInput=null
StandardOutput=append:/data1/liyapeng/program/LLMCL/summary/two_backbone_pct01_20261017/completion_observer_20261018/observer_nohup.log
StandardError=inherit
Restart=no
KillMode=process
[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
